description: Book a 60-minute mock interview with a host, the person attending as guest. starts_at must be one of the host's open slots exactly (RFC 3339) and topic one of the topics that host offers. Returns the booked mock with the counterpart's handle and the meeting link. A guest may hold at most 3 upcoming mocks.

starts_at.description: The slot's start, RFC 3339, exactly as listed.

timezone.description: IANA time zone the times are shown in, e.g. Europe/Berlin. An unknown or missing zone falls back to UTC; the result names the zone it used.

name: buddy_mock_book
title: Book a mock interview
